description: Waxhead Reef Safe Zinc Oxide Sunscreen Stick SPF 30, Face, Kids, Big 3.7oz No synthetic coatings
features: 4-Ingredient Zinc Oxide Mineral Sunscreen Stick: Only zinc oxide, organic coconut oil, beeswax, and vanilla extract. No oxybenzone, octinoxate, parabens, or fragrances. EWG 1 rated mineral sunscreen for families who want truly non-toxic, food-grade sun protection
Baby and Kids Sunscreen for Sensitive Skin: Hypoallergenic and pediatrician approved for babies, toddlers, kids, and sensitive skin. Safe if little ones lick or touch their mouths after application

Sport and Surf Sunscreen: 25% non-nano zinc oxide creates a physical barrier that stays on through sweat, saltwater, and 80 minutes of water resistance. Trusted by surfers, lifeguards, fishing guides, and outdoor athletes for long sessions in intense sun

Visible White Layer by Design: This reef safe sunscreen goes on white, so you see where you're protected. Warm, dot, and spread for even coverage. Non-nano zinc oxide only, Hawaii and Mexico compliant and made in USA. Solid stick format is TSA-friendly for carry-on travel and won't leak in your beach bag

Tattoo and Scar UV Defense, Long-Lasting Value: Thick zinc paste gives exceptional tattoo and scar UV protection on face, lips, ears, and shoulders. 3.7 oz jumbo stick lasts for months, often all season, making it a high-value alternative to cheap chemical sunscreens
